        (select min(expires_at) from agent_connections
          where removed_at is null and revoked_at is null and agent_connections.bridge_account_id is null
            and (cleanup_reason is null or cleanup_reason = 'narrowed')),
        (select $1::timestamptz where exists (
          select 1 from agent_connections
          where (cleanup_requested_at is not null and cleanup_completed_at is null)
            or (removed_at is null and (agent_connections.bridge_account_id is not null
    and agent_connections.revoked_at is null and (case
    when agent_connections.revoked_at is not null then 'ended'
    when agent_connections.bridge_account_id is null then (case
      when agent_connections.token_hash is not null
        and agent_connections.expires_at > $2::timestamptz then 'live'
      else 'ended' end)
    when not (agent_connections."grant"->>'scope' = 'everything'
  or coalesce((agent_connections."grant"->>'tasks')::boolean, false)) then 'ended'
    when not exists (
  select 1 from channel_accounts bridge_account
  join integration_connections bridge_channel
    on bridge_channel.id = bridge_account.connection_id
  where bridge_account.id = agent_connections.bridge_account_id
    and bridge_channel.owner_user_id = agent_connections.user_id) then 'ended'
    else (case
    when not exists (
    select 1 from channel_accounts bridge_account
    join integration_connections bridge_channel
      on bridge_channel.id = bridge_account.connection_id
    where bridge_account.id = "agent_connections"."bridge_account_id"
      and bridge_account.status <> 'revoked'
      and bridge_channel.status <> 'revoked') or not exists (
    select 1 from channel_accounts bridge_account
    join integration_connections bridge_channel
      on bridge_channel.id = bridge_account.connection_id
    left join integration_connections bridge_source
      on bridge_source.id = bridge_channel.source_connection_id
    where bridge_account.id = "agent_connections"."bridge_account_id"
      and (bridge_channel.transport_kind <> 'computer' or (
        bridge_source.status is not null and bridge_source.status <> 'revoked'
        and bridge_source.computer_access = 'read-write'
        and bridge_source.owner_user_id = bridge_channel.owner_user_id
        and exists (
          select 1 from device_drivers bridge_driver
          join devices bridge_device on bridge_device.id = bridge_driver.device_id
          join runners bridge_runner on bridge_runner.id = bridge_driver.runner_id
          where bridge_driver.device_id = coalesce(bridge_source.device_id, bridge_source.runner_id)
            and bridge_driver.role = 'self' and bridge_driver.detached_at is null
            and bridge_device.removed_at is null and bridge_runner.revoked_at is null
            and bridge_runner.id = bridge_channel.runner_id)))) then 'ended'
    when exists (
    select 1 from channel_accounts bridge_account
    join integration_connections bridge_channel
      on bridge_channel.id = bridge_account.connection_id
    where bridge_account.id = "agent_connections"."bridge_account_id"
      and bridge_account.status = 'connected'
      and bridge_channel.status in ('pending', 'connected', 'needs-attention')) then 'live'
    else 'waiting' end) end) = 'ended'))
        ))
      ) as next

select thread.id as thread_id, thread.created_by, thread.updated_at
    from threads thread
  join personal_settings settings on settings.owner_id = thread.created_by
  join users person on person.id = settings.owner_id
  left join thread_visits visit
    on visit.thread_id = thread.id and visit.user_id = thread.created_by
    where thread.purpose = 'task' and thread.listed and thread.done_at is null
    and thread.status = 'idle' and not thread.input_queue_paused
    and person.disabled_at is null and settings.quiet_task_days > 0
    and greatest(thread.updated_at, visit.updated_at)
      <= $1::timestamptz - make_interval(days => settings.quiet_task_days)
    and not exists (
      select 1 from triggers where anchor_thread_id = thread.id and status in ('active', 'paused'))
    and not exists (
      select 1 from runs where thread_id = thread.id
        and status in ($2, $3, $4, $5))
    and not exists (
      select 1 from thread_inputs where thread_id = thread.id
        and state in ('pending', 'claimed', 'unknown') and policy <> 'report')
    and not exists (
      select 1 from delegations where status = 'open'
        and (child_thread_id = thread.id or parent_thread_id = thread.id))
    and not exists (
      select 1 from requests where originating_thread_id = thread.id and status = 'pending')
    and not ((select case when status in ('completed', 'failed', 'interrupted') then completed_at end
    from runs where thread_id = thread.id and maintenance is null order by run_ordinal desc limit 1) is not null and (visit.last_visited_at is null or (select case when status in ('completed', 'failed', 'interrupted') then completed_at end
    from runs where thread_id = thread.id and maintenance is null order by run_ordinal desc limit 1) > visit.last_visited_at))
      -- The shortest choice, so the planner can range-scan threads_quiet_candidates.
      and thread.updated_at <= $6::timestamptz - interval '1 day'
      
    order by thread.id
    limit $7
